description: Native reference choose/if branches, 2026-09-19. Synthetic tree in diagram-layout-fixture.js. Each numeric candidate branch creates a presentation node named resultN; values were read from presName in native-resaved diagram data. Variable cases likewise record the selected true/false branch. Scope override records chMax in every data point presLayoutVars; these do not replace layout-node varLst values. The numericDeep cases extend the tree with extraEdges, reaching five levels with unequal branch depths.
